title: ChillDarkMode
description: Basic Dark Mode GUI changes. I made it because most Dark Modes don't usually have built in hearts, so i added them :)
body:
Just a little GUI pack i made :) it says i need 200 characters, so im gonna write about inspiration.

I was inspired by DDM and Mandela's Dark Mode. The reason i didnt want to use them is that i didnt want to use their hearts/expeirence bar and wanted my own, so i made my own pack.

enjoy!

if u find anything wrong, please join the discord and @ me  (there is a bug in the modrinth app that shows that the pack is called either "assets.zip" or "chilldaarkmode.zip" and idk how to fix it)
